messages:
maya-sales: Heads-up — FinTrust POC failing after they switched to their VPC private endpoint. Clients see TLS handshake errors and occasional 504s. Need quick triage.
raj-se: Can you paste the client error and which host it resolves to?
maya-sales: Client: 'SSL: certificate verify failed' then 'connection reset by peer'. DNS returns 10.20.30.5 for api.private.fintrust.local.
jo-sre: That suggests either the proxy re-signed certs or the client can't reach OCSP/CRL. Do they have TLS inspection on that subnet?
talia-net: Also check security groups on the ENI, route table, and whether their NACL is blocking ephemeral ports.
raj-se: Asked them to run `openssl s_client -connect 10.20.30.5:443 -servername api.private.fintrust.local -showcerts` and to post output.
fintrust-infra: Output: "CONNECTED" then "no peer certificate available" and then connection closed.
jo-sre: "no peer certificate" = TLS terminated before we saw it. Likely a middlebox. If their proxy is resigning, it needs to trust our CA or bypass the host.
maya-sales: Security wants a minimal allowlist for POC. What IPs/ports do we require?
talia-net: For POC provide these egress IPs: 52.11.66.77, 52.11.66.78 (control plane) and 52.11.66.79 (model). Allow outbound 443, DNS (53 UDP/TCP), and OCSP endpoints. Also ensure local DNS resolves to the ENI private IP (split-horizon).
raj-se: Quick workaround if they can't change proxy: run a jump host in-app-subnet and `curl --resolve "api.private.fintrust.local:443:10.20.30.5" -v https://api.private.fintrust.local/health` to isolate DNS.
jo-sre: I'll spin up a debug listener that responds on 8443 (plain TCP) so they can validate routing without TLS. ETA 1h.
fintrust-infra: We'll try disabling TLS interception for that hostname and will test. Security approval needed; expecting 3-4 hours.
ops-bot: POC ticket created: POC-5909 assigned to jo-sre and raj-se, due 2026-04-06.
maya-sales: Thanks. Please keep this thread as source of truth.
fintrust-update (3h later): Disabled interception and added allowlist. Health check returns 200 when hitting private IP. POC flows now working.
